title: Don't Look Back
description: Forget the safe and peaceful world of Minecraft. This modpack is a pure psychological horror experience, bringing entities to your world that watch you from the shadows, trace your steps, and hunt you down when you least expect it. Watch your back...
body:
**Don't Look Back**


**This time, terror has followed you all the way outside.**


**Remember, you're never alone**.


**Don't sleep until you're finished!**


**If you don't complete your task, you won't see the morning**.


**Someone is always watching you**


**Be careful while hunting!**

This modpack throws Minecraft's peaceful world aside. Entities watching, following, and sometimes chasing you won't leave you alone. They won't let you sleep at night. Even if you stay awake, you're not safe. There are different entities waiting for you in the mine.

**NOTE**: SOME MODS ADD FOGGY EDGES TO THE SCREEN AT NIGHT, SO YOU NEED TO KEEP THE GUI SCALE AT 5.

⚠️ A Quick Advice: Put on your headphones, turn off the lights, and... **don't look back**.
